notes.title: Updates Note - Feb/25/2018
notes.content:
A lot of stuff have been changed with this update.

[b]Car Change:[/b]
The appearance of the car has been changed, and the mechanics as well. It is now more responsive when you steer it

[b]"Completing road = Time added" - Has been removed:[/b]
You do not get added time when you have surpass the different kinds of roads. 

[b]"No tolerence policy when hitting pedestrians" - Has been removed[/b]
You are not instantly Game Over when you touch the pedestrians with your car. Not if, but when you hit the pedestrians he corpse will splatter all over the place, and you get your time reduced as a punishment

[b]3 Buffs implementet:[/b]
There has been implementet 3 buffs, Time, Beer and Maniac. These buff will appear on the road and have difference effect when you collect them.

Time Buff give you added time.
Beer gets you drunk which makes it harder to drive for a X amount of time
Maniac mode allows you to drive down pedestrians which gives you added time

[b]Work in progress[/b]
• Leaderboard/public highscore, 
• Multiplayer 
• Twitch Interaction
